Classes

Something for everyone.

Kids, beginners, women’s fitness and fighters — pick your class, turn up, and train. No experience needed for any of them.

Kids

Kids boxing

Tuesday · 6–6:45pm

Boxing for kids — footwork, pads and fitness in a fun, safe session that builds confidence as well as coordination.

$8 per class
Beginners

Learn to box

Monday & Wednesday · 7–8pm

Never boxed before? Start here. Learn the basics properly — stance, guard, punches and movement — with people at the same stage.

Beginners welcomeMon & Wed nights

Women’s BoxFit

Tue 7–8pm · Thu 6–7pm

02
Head coach

Led by Brendan.

“Strong body. Strong mind. Bright future.”

Head coach Brendan Thomas has run BT Boxing and Fitness since 2004 — more than twenty years of coaching Invercargill boxers, from kids taking their first class to fighters stepping into the ring.

The gym trains out of the Collegiate Rugby Clubrooms on Lindisfarne St — a proper old-school boxing gym, with bags, ring and a team that looks after its own.

To join, or to ask about a class, email Brendan directly.
